name: Ousu Chiaki
source: Chiaki, despite the name and appearance, is a guy. With feminine features, the beginning scenes show that he is forced to crossdress by someone named “[url=/c31379]Suzu-nee[/url]”, and the details of this relationship is soon revealed. Chiaki is normally a coward, being easily startled or intimidated, but with his relationship with [url=https://vndb.org/c22678]Ena[/url], he slowly changes throughout the entire game.
